name: Bingo! Cream & Onion Potato Chips
ingredients_raw: Potato (57.9%), refined palmolein oil, seasoning mix [milk solids (1.8%), refined sugar, dextrose, onion powder (1.0%), iodised salt, dried parsley leaves (0.4%), soya sauce powder, cheese powder (0.2%), acidity regulator (INS 330), anticaking agent (INS 551), flavour enhancers (INS 627, INS 631)], iodised salt. Contains added flavours: natural flavours and natural flavouring substances - cream, and nature identical flavouring substances - cheese.
